name: Layout Placer
description: Place objects during editor playtest, save gimmicks that get pasted automatically, and keep generated objects visible.

offset-x.name: X offset
offset-x.description: Place objects this many units ahead of the player (a block is 30).

new-clicks.name: New gimmick: clicks
new-clicks.description: How many clicks the gimmick you save with G belongs to (1 to 10).

new-mode.name: New gimmick: gamemode
new-mode.description: Gamemode the gimmick you save with G is used in.

auto-paste.name: Auto paste gimmicks
auto-paste.description: Paste saved gimmicks during a playtest when your clicks match.

window.name: Click window (seconds)
window.description: All clicks of a gimmick must happen within this time.

min-gap.name: Minimum gap (units)
min-gap.description: Minimum distance between two pasted gimmicks.

stretch.name: Vary spacing
stretch.description: Randomly stretch or squeeze a pasted gimmick horizontally (80% to 120%). Off = pasted exactly as saved.

show-generated.name: Show generated objects
show-generated.description: During a playtest, keep every object created along the path visible.

safety-margin.name: Safety margin (units)
safety-margin.description: Blocks and spikes of a pasted gimmick that come closer than this to your route (with your current hitbox: normal, mini, wave, mini wave) are left out.
